The '''V-6 pyro grenade''' was a [[fire grenade]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The V-6 pyro grenade appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the types of grenades usable in player-vs-player combat.
